h1: Sun visor clip replacement, printed from your photo
answer_first: We print a replacement sun visor retainer clip made to your photo or part number, in PETG. Send a clear photo with a coin for scale and your year, model and trim, and we quote within 24 hours on business days, from $12.
fits: Vehicle-specific; send your year, model and trim and we confirm the fit
problem: The clip that holds the visor in its hook cracks or goes missing, so the visor droops or flips down on its own. It is a tiny piece of plastic on a visor that is otherwise fine. The clip is often what fails first because it flexes every time the visor is moved.
oem_situation: The clip is typically sold only as part of the visor or trim, so a single clip is hard to find. We make one to your photo or part number instead.
our_part: We print PETG, which holds up in a hot cabin where PLA softens, and we do not use PLA for car interiors. We need a clear photo of the old clip or the empty hook, with a coin or ruler beside it, plus your year, model and trim. We make interior trim parts only, not airbag, seatbelt, brake, steering, lighting or fuel parts.
price_note: per clip; pairs for both visors quoted lower per unit

how_to_order: Photograph the broken clip, or the empty hook on the headliner, with a coin in the shot. Note your year, model and trim.
Send photos on the request page, with any part number on the old piece. We reply with a quote within 24 hours on business days.
Approve the quote and we print the part, usually in 5 to 10 business days after approval, then ship it to you.

faqs.a: Visor clips are vehicle-specific, so we match yours from photos and your year, model and trim before printing. If it is a poor candidate for printing, we say so.

faqs.q: Is a printed clip as strong as the original?
faqs.a: We do not claim it matches the original. Printed layers are weakest where they pull apart, so we orient the print so the main load runs along them. A visor clip is light-duty, and PETG is usually enough.

faqs.q: Will it soften in a hot, parked car?
faqs.a: PLA softens in a hot car, so we do not use it. We print PETG for cabins and can use ASA if the car sits in strong sun.

faqs.q: How do I photograph the clip for a fit check?
faqs.a: Photograph the clip from the front, side and back, and the hook it snaps into, on a plain background with a coin or ruler beside it. Send your year, model, trim and any part number on the old piece.

faqs.q: Do you make safety-related car parts?
faqs.a: No. We make interior and trim parts only, and we do not make airbag, seatbelt, brake, steering, lighting or fuel parts.
